title: Boldini's Portrait of His Father
content: Giovanni Boldiniwas just 25 when he painted this portrait of his father Antonio.Antonio Boldini by Giovanni Boldini, 1867Giovanni grew up in an artistic family. His father was a painter of religious subjects Ferrara, Italy and his brother was an architect. Young Giovanni traveled to Florence, where he studied at the Academy. He befriended other realist painters in the school of Italian impressionistic realism known as theMacchiaioli.There's aBoldini exhibitiongoing on now in Paris until July 24th (Thanks, Peace)Giovanni Boldinion Wikipedia.Book:Giovanni Boldini: Paintings & Drawings
